invariants.rationale: The method draw is called on 'font', so it must be non-null at this point.
'font.draw' is called with 'batch' as an argument, so 'batch' is expected to be non-null.
It is common for drawing routines to expect a non-negative maxWidth for rendering text.
If the font is flipped, a negative y might display text offscreen, so in practice, y is usually >= 0 for drawing.
Text drawing commonly expects a non-negative x coordinate as it represents a screen position.
